grants.title: Unlimited Partner Awards (Sherman Theatre Cardiff)
grants.matchReason: Specifically for D/deaf, disabled, and neurodivergent artists (ADHD/Dyslexia). Direct partnership with Sherman Theatre Cardiff.
grants.summary: Commission for ambitious new work by disabled/neurodivergent artists. Expression of interest (EOI) stage accepts written, audio, or video application.
keyPoints: Stage 1: Short Expression of Interest (approx 500 words or 3-minute video/audio).
Sherman Theatre Cardiff offers co-commissioning, rehearsal space, and dramaturgical support.
Must highlight your unique choreographic voice and community relevance.

grants.title: Creative Steps for Individuals
grants.matchReason: Directly targets Welsh-based artists who identify as culturally/ethnically diverse, D/deaf, disabled, neurodivergent, or from low-income backgrounds.
grants.summary: Funding for career step-changes: creative business coaching, portfolio enhancement, digital systems, and sustainable artistic practice development.
keyPoints: Covers mentoring, creative software/digital presence, financial sustainability.
Short EOI via the Arts Council of Wales Portal.
High priority for Cardiff-based independent artists.

grants.title: The Churchill Fellowship 2027
grants.matchReason: Open to any UK citizen over 18 regardless of qualifications. Fully funds 4–8 weeks overseas research to discover innovative practices and bring them back to the UK/Wales.
grants.summary: Travel fellowship proposal: Researching commercial choreographic direction & inclusive dance pedagogy in Los Angeles / USA, returning knowledge to benefit Welsh youth & dancers.
keyPoints: Opened 1 September 2026; Closes 20 October 2026.
All international flights, accommodation, food, and daily stipend covered.
Two-stage process: Phase 1 is a straightforward online application.

grants.title: Create: Creative Practice
grants.matchReason: Full £10,000 application and balanced budget already formulated and formatted locally.
grants.summary: Intensive 3-month research and creation project: developing Sadie's commercial-contemporary fusion movement language, mentoring with senior choreographers, and creative filming.
keyPoints: Master copy-paste text ready in FULL_ACW_APPLICATION_COPY_PASTE.md.
Excel budget balanced at exactly £10,000 (Creative Practice Project Budget Template).
5-page portfolio and 2-page Artistic CV ready as PDFs.

grants.title: International Opportunities Fund (IOF)
grants.matchReason: Dedicated fund supporting Welsh artists to attend international festivals, masterclasses, and showcase opportunities worldwide.
grants.summary: Application drafted in NEXT_GRANT_WAI_INTERNATIONAL_OPPORTUNITIES_FUND.md for international training and networking in Paris/LA.
keyPoints: Rolling assessment throughout 2026/2027.
Eligible costs: Flights, accommodation, masterclass tuition, per diems.
Draft file ready in project folder.

grants.title: Independent Dancer Retraining / Transition Grant
grants.matchReason: Specifically for UK professional dancers with 5+ years performance experience transitioning into choreography, movement direction, or creative leadership.
grants.summary: Retraining grant supporting Sadie's transition into high-profile Movement Direction for screen, theatre, and music video production.
keyPoints: Draft prepared in NEXT_GRANT_DCD_CAREER_TRANSITION.md.
Funds accredited training, director mentorships, and camera/movement technology courses.
Sadie qualifies based on commercial, West End, and TV performance credits.

grants.title: Awards for All Wales
grants.matchReason: Focuses on community empowerment, wellbeing, and youth arts engagement across Welsh communities (Cardiff, Newport, Valleys).
grants.summary: Community dance initiative: Empowering low-income and neurodivergent young dancers through street dance, movement expression, and mental wellbeing workshops.
keyPoints: Grants from £300 to £20,000 for up to 2 years.
Simple online application with decisions in 12 weeks.
Ideal for collaborative project with Jukebox Collective or local community hubs.
